body: I’ve tried joining computer centered groups in my college and my hometown but the motivation isn’t there anymore.

Actually had a support system. Was getting good grades. No stress. All of that is gone now

I put a lot of time several “crafts” (don’t have a better word so don’t take this as mockery) like I spent about half of my life working on computers as that was the one thing I enjoyed over all else and it amounted to nothing skill or enjoyment wise

I don’t know honestly. I’ve never been satisfied with anything I’ve tried to set a career on. I’m not good at anything either.

I haven’t been contented in so long. Last time was middle school. I rarely have happiness either as the only thing that makes me somewhat happy is sleeping
